paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Antigonus. Gittin 31, end of a: Yochanan says, etc.; Elazar ben Antigonus in Elazar son of Yannai’s name. Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Metzia 7:6; Gittin 3:8; Chullin, mishnah 5, 9a, and Ellu Tereifot 55b. Shabbat 150b: in Elazar ben Yaakov’s name; Asheri: Yose; Rif: Elazar son of Yannai. Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 5, mishnah 2: “Ze'ira and Elazar ben Antigonus, son of” should read “in Elazar son of Yannai’s name.” In Yannai’s name, in Yehudah Berabbi’s name [בר׳; attachment uncertain], in Yochanan’s time—thus not a tanna. Elazar son of Yannai in his name; see above. See Yochanan: Tosafot, Ketubbot, allows a tannaitic Yochanan.
